capabilities: reduce plugin size and startup time by dropping bundled dependencies
keep AnyBlock functionality without mermaid, plantuml or markmap
pair with other plugins to restore diagram features
disambiguation: Not a standalone diagram renderer; it is a slimmed distribution of the AnyBlock plugin whose main functionality lives in the main AnyBlock repository.
extras: Documentation for the min version is incomplete; the README points to the main AnyBlock repository for details and says more documentation will be added later. Mermaid still works via Obsidian's built-in version, with a minor refresh glitch during editing. The README mixes English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: obsidian-any-block mini version. Remove some features and dependencies to reduce size and improve performance.
problem: The full AnyBlock plugin is heavy (8.82MB, 424ms startup at v3.2.1), which slows vault loading and memory use.

relations.evidence: AnyBlock min version. Remove some features and dependencies to reduce size and improve performance.

summary: Trimmed-down distribution of the AnyBlock plugin that removes mermaid, plantuml and markmap dependencies to cut size and startup time.
